reason: A persistent OpenCode Go usage dashboard that visualizes account quotas, token consumption, and estimated spending from official usage data and local DeepSeek Harness session logs.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框下方常驻显示 OpenCode Go 配额、Token 消耗和花费统计，并支持按范围与模型查看明细。
summaries.en: A persistent OpenCode Go usage dashboard showing quota, token consumption, and spending details by scope and model.

capabilities: Reads local DeepSeek Harness session logs to aggregate token usage and spending
Fetches OpenCode Go quota and official pricing data over HTTP
Displays a masked account API key and provides a local copy action
Exposes local HTTP endpoints and a usage query tool
